data.narrative:
Astro Mechanica is a Series A-stage company in the Supersonic & Hypersonic sector, founded by Ian Brooke. The company has raised $27M+ to date. The valuation universe for this segment is limited: two public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and two private peers (Boom Supersonic, Hermeus) exist in the Supersonic & Hypersonic space, though narrow-filter peer matching proved insufficient for median-based triangulation.

Given data constraints, the Stage-Progression method is the applicable approach. Using the $27M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $54M. This reflects the expected value increase between funding rounds in early-stage venture markets.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $46M to $62M, with a median point of $54M. This range incorporates conservative and optimistic interpretations of stage-based multiples around the central estimate. Key uncertainties include the lack of statistically meaningful peer comps in this nascent sector, making stage-progression the only reliable triangulation input. Market conditions in advanced aerospace and validation of technical milestones will be material to realizations within this range. Investors should treat this as indicative pending deeper due diligence on product development and regulatory pathway.
